description: Self-hosted Renovate, run by .github/workflows/renovate.yml with a personal access token. Every update lands in one weekly PR into development and merges itself once the required CI checks pass.
Only the schedule weekday differs between philfreshman repos: diffpack Monday, diffpack-proxy Tuesday, diffpack-engine Wednesday, scheunenhaus Thursday, kasia-swiezak-portfolio Friday.
Versions must be public for 14 days before they are proposed. Security fixes skip both the weekday schedule and the delay (vulnerabilityAlerts defaults).
Pinned tool versions that no built-in manager sees get a `# renovate: datasource=… depName=…` comment above a `*_VERSION:` key (workflows) or `ENV/ARG *_VERSION=` (Dockerfiles).

packageRules.description: One PR for everything: all managers, all update types including major
The Renovate image tag in renovate.yml is an expression; RENOVATE_VERSION next to it is updated through npm instead, because GHCR has no release dates for the 14-day delay
